scripts.build:site: npm run generate && node scripts/write-build-info.mjs && fumapress build
scripts.format: oxlint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src scripts tests press.config.tsx vite.config.ts && oxfmt --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src scripts tests press.config.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --format unix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src scripts tests press.config.tsx vite.config.ts && oxfmt --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src scripts tests press.config.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.test: tsx --test scripts/beginner-copy.test.ts scripts/build-info.test.ts scripts/seo-contract.test.ts scripts/docs-contract.test.ts scripts/api-contract.test.ts scripts/preview-contract.test.ts scripts/template-contract.test.ts scripts/product-foundation.test.tsx scripts/fumapress-runtime.test.ts scripts/chart-contract.test.tsx scripts/github-stars.test.ts scripts/dependency-contract.test.ts scripts/initial-js-budget.test.ts scripts/verify-deployment.test.mjs
